title: An owed batch-bind send shares bind_in_progress with rebinds, so an admission during the send drops a changed work binding or backs off
outcome: An owed verification_bind send in flight has its own in-flight flag. Settings-reset quiescence and the reset checkpoint claim wait on it (session_crud.rs wait_for_engram_project_reset_quiescence and claim_engram_project_reset_checkpoints_until), but the admission work-binding refresh and the bind paths do not read it as a rebind. An admission arriving during a send therefore neither drops a changed work binding (engram_work_binding_refresh.rs, the bind_in_progress early return) nor backs off with "Engram binding is already in progress".
acceptance: An owed batch-bind send shares bind_in_progress with rebinds, so an admission during the send drops a changed work binding or backs off is done
